constraints: Native startup Shell commands and fields 14,15,20,22 were runtime validated on this 1.10.7 build; other candidates remain static.

This experiment exported baseline before mutation and verified initial zeros/restoration afterward; it had no runtime baseline guard before applying. Future experiments should guard or restore actual values.
Flag 21 bypasses gyro acquisition and must not be used as a log setting.
Flag 22 is a tick-modulo condition, not a guarantee of a fixed output frequency.
Flags 20 and 22 also enable grid debug prints; output can exceed raw gyro traffic.
The fourth raw GyroData value is A1702C36; mode-1 gyro read fills only the first 3 values. It is not a valid sample timestamp.
Printed log ticks and per-sample sensor hardware timestamps are distinct; no hardware timestamp recovered.
Native text diagnostics are for bounded validation, not a final lossless high-rate logger.
